name: Camping Ambach am See
beschreibung: The Campingplatz Camping Ambach am See is located directly on the shore of a lake in Tirol. The facility includes pitches for caravans, motorhomes, and tents. The sanitary facilities are in good condition. A private stretch of beach is available. The lake is ideal for swimming and water sports. There are marked hiking trails in the surrounding area. A restaurant on site offers food.
